name: CW-78
description: Roland CR-78 CompuRhythm - 14 circuit-modelled voices built from the 1979 service notes and held to Roland's own factory alignment table, plus the machine's 34 preset rhythms. 7 distortion types per voice and on the master, reverb and delay sends, bus compressor.
author: athousanddetails; every voice modelled from the Roland CR-78 service notes (June 1979), VG-11A voicing board
